items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: He says, well let me tell you, I'm now a conductor for NBC, and he says, I certainly would like for you to write some music for me. ... So I met him the next morning, at 9:30 up at NBC. ... They signed me up to a contract -- Now I'm a staff arranger at NBC.

ctx.x: Because I never made a rehearsal and I never -- but listen, you check that with Jerry and he'll bear me out man.
